Treating Provider Clinical Summary
The patient presented after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reports
neck and back strain. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injuries
described. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the
cervical and lumbar regions. No earlier injury to these areas is known. Care has
included 39 visits, with near-daily sessions for much of the course. Additional body
regions were added several weeks after the collision, and the volume of treatment is
well above what is typical for a strain of this kind. Billing records show no repeated
charges for the same services. The plan going forward is active rehabilitation with
scheduled reassessment and a review of discharge criteria once functoinal goals are
met.
